INSERT INTO dataset_columns ( id, dataset_version_id, table_id, column_name, ordinal, data_type, physical_name, logical_type, clickhouse_type, nullable, file_id, created_at ) VALUES
( #{column.id,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{column.datasetVersionId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{column.tableId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{column.columnName}, #{column.ordinal}, #{column.dataType}, #{column.physicalName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{column.logicalType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{column.clickhouseType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{column.nullable}, #{column.fileId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{column.createdAt,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dataset_columns WHERE dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY table_id, ordinal
SELECT FROM dataset_columns WHERE table_id = #{tableId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} ORDER BY ordinal

SELECT c.id AS column_id, b.field_id, f.name AS field_name, f.display_name AS field_display_name, d.id AS dataset_id, d.name AS dataset_name, t.id AS table_id, t.table_name, c.column_name, COALESCE(c.logical_type, c.data_type) AS data_type, c.ordinal FROM dataset_columns c JOIN dataset_versions d ON d.id = c.dataset_version_id JOIN dataset_tables t ON t.id = c.table_id LEFT JOIN dataset_field_bindings b ON b.column_id = c.id AND b.dataset_version_id = c.dataset_version_id AND b.owner_id = #{ownerId} LEFT JOIN field_definitions f ON f.id = b.field_id WHERE c.dataset_version_id = #{datasetVersionId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} AND d.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY t.ordinal, c.ordinal
